subject.title: feat(mac): native pairing approval dialog with instant decisions

question: What native-app proof is required before accepting optimistic dismissal in the macOS pairing approval flow?
rationale: The screenshot verifies appearance but cannot establish the timing, restoration, focus, and notification behavior that constitute the main functional change.

options.title: Require lifecycle recording
options.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted native recording shows immediate approve and reject dismissal and forced-failure card restoration.

options.title: Accept screenshot and tests
options.body: Allow merge after platform checks while accepting that the optimistic interaction was not directly observed in contributor proof.

options.title: Split the behavior change
options.body: Land native chrome separately and defer optimistic dismissal if maintainers do not want it without stronger proof.

recommendation.title: Require lifecycle recording
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until a redacted native recording shows immediate approve and reject dismissal and forced-failure card restoration.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the existing pairing panel and this follow-up behavior, though another macOS owner may make the final protected-label decision.
